verdict.rationale: Jan is a desktop app billed as an open-source ChatGPT/Claude replacement that downloads and runs local LLMs. Its docs describe in-app chat features: inline tool-call approval panels inside the chat and assistants applied to every conversation in a project. Together these show a built-in graphical chat interface for local models. missing for 10: direct first-party documentation of the chat UI itself (threads, streaming, regeneration, model switching in-chat), independent hands-on corroboration beyond a brief 'it's been okay' comment.
